title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Increment to the Leak Adjustment Credit Share
content:
# Renewal Loyalty Increment on Leak Credits — Utility Services Program

**Term.** Under Larkspur's renewal loyalty program, the credit share of a Utility Services Program leak adjustment is raised by the renewal loyalty increment of a leak adjustment:

| Renewal rent changes on record for the lease | Increment added to the credit share |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.10 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | 0.05 |
| none | 0.0 |

The increment is added to the credit share, and the raised share is applied to the credited leak excess.

**Records read.** Rent changes recorded with the reason renewal on the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease.

*Cases (hypothetical credit share of 0.60):* with four renewals the share applied is 0.70; with one renewal 0.65; with none 0.60.
